mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as bdPreparedByName, c2.C_Name as bdAuditUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as bdPreparedByAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as bdAuditUnitAbbName, mn.Bd_Prepared_By, mn.Bd_Audit_Unit from Inv_Budget_Declare mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Bd_Prepared_By=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Bd_Audit_Unit=c2.C_Id where mn.P_Id=#{pId} order by Bd_Create_Time desc limit 1

select c1.C_Name as bdPreparedByName, c2.C_Name as bdAuditUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as bdPreparedByAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as bdAuditUnitAbbName, pro1.P_Name as bdSplitFormName, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Budget_Declare mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Bd_Prepared_By=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Bd_Audit_Unit=c2.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro1 on pro1.P_Id=mn.Bd_Split_Form left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.P_Id=#{pId} and mn.Bd_State=7 order by mn.Bd_State_Time desc limit 1

select c1.C_Name as bdPreparedByName, c2.C_Name as bdAuditUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as bdPreparedByAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as bdAuditUnitAbbName, pro1.P_Name as bdSplitFormName, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Budget_Declare mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Bd_Prepared_By=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Bd_Audit_Unit=c2.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro1 on pro1.P_Id=mn.Bd_Split_Form left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Bd_Id=#{bdId}
